description: Verify that Client-mode FindService is bounded to Start-Up Phase, absent in Main Phase
approach:
[Objective]
FindService cadence: client-mode emits FindService during the Start-Up Phase but stops once the service is found and Main Phase begins.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Observation Start-Up Phase: DUT FindService present.
3. Wait until Main Phase.
4. Observation Main Phase: NO DUT FindService.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT followed client-mode FindService rule — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_findservice: No DUT FindService during start phase
verdicts.Fail_phase4_findservice_in_main_phase: DUT FindService observed during Main Phase
